table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SalesPerson=SM.Name,
	Customer = A.Name,
	ItemName=I.Name,
	NetSaleQty = SUM(S.Qty),
	NetSaleValue = SUM(S.Value)
FROM
	Accounts A,
	Item I,
	SalesMan SM,
	(SELECT
		SManCode=:ai_smancode,
		CustCode=19,
		ICode,
		Qty = 0.0000,
		Value = 0.00
	FROM
		Item
	WHERE
		ICode IN (:ai_icode)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		SL.SManCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.ICode,
		Qty = SUM(SD.LooseQty),
		Value = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01) )
	FROM
		SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD
	WHERE
		SL.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
		SL.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
		SL.SManCode = :ai_smancode AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SD.ICode IN (:ai_icode)
	GROUP BY 
		SL.SManCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		SL.SManCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.ICode,
		Qty = SUM(SD.LooseQty),
		Value = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01) )
	FROM
		SaleLedger SL, SaleInvDetail SD
	WHERE
		SL.ImpactInventory = 'N' AND
		SL.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
		SL.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
		SL.SManCode = :ai_smancode AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SD.ICode IN (:ai_icode)
	GROUP BY 
		SL.SManCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		SL.SManCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.ICode,
		Qty = - SUM(SD.LooseQty),
		Value = - SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01) )
	FROM
		SRLedger SL, SRDetail SD
	WHERE
		SL.Date >= :ad_startdate AND
		SL.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
		SL.SManCode = :ai_smancode AND
		SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
		SD.ICode IN (:ai_icode)
	GROUP BY 
		SL.SManCode,
		SL.CustCode,
		SD.ICode) S
WHERE
	I.ICode = S.ICode AND
	S.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode
GROUP BY
	SM.Name,
	A.Name,
	I.Name
ORDER BY
	SalesPerson,
	Customer,
	ItemName
